Want to experience the nano-texture of an iPad screen without a long-term commitment? Astropad has launched a brand-new version of Rock Paper Pencil, adding a second writing feel while retaining the removable design.

Graphite feel arrives on Apple Pencil and iPad — Rock Paper Pencil 4.0

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 pairs a nano-texture screen protector with special Apple Pencil nibs. For the first time, buyers can choose between the smooth feel of a ballpoint pen and the soft, grainier drag of graphite.

The all-new graphite nib is designed to mimic a 2B pencil, including the extra friction artists love for sketching, shading and expressive strokes.

Astropad says developing this new option took roughly a year, using a standard 2B pencil as the benchmark. They say the finished product even replicates the look and sound of real graphite.

Choose between ballpoint and standard pencil feel

At the same time, the existing steel ballpoint nib remains available for writing, inking, precise lines and neat note-taking. Every Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 set now ships with four Apple Pencil nibs in total: two ballpoint and two graphite.

The screen protector itself is unchanged. Astropad's proprietary NanoCling system uses static adhesion instead of glue, so it can be applied, removed and reused at any time without leaving any residue.

The company says the adhesion is stronger than magnets, while still delivering a bubble-free application and easy removal. Its micro-texture mimics the roughness of fine-grain paper, providing friction and better control.

The best matte screen protector for iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 doesn't treat the Apple Pencil nib or screen texture as isolated changes, but as one system. Astropad says the special nibs are designed specifically to work with the nano-texture protector. The new graphite nibs are made from POM, while the ballpoint version uses steel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is on sale from today at US$49.99, with free worldwide shipping. You can also pick up the 3.0 version at a discount while stocks last.
